BEFORE YOU BEGIN

A few things you might be wondering.

About building websites with Atomic.

Can I start without knowing how to code?

Yes. Describe the pages and style you want in plain language. Use the canvas to refine the generated screens, then review and test the site before publishing. You can also inspect and download the source.

Can I use my own images and design references?

Yes. Atomic supports image uploads and design references. Bring your own photography and brand materials, then use the canvas controls and conversation to refine the result.

Can I publish on my own domain?

Atomic supports publishing on an Atomic subdomain. Custom domains are included in the proposed paid plans; you register the domain separately. See the publishing guide for setup and verification.

Can my website collect enquiries?

You can build an enquiry workflow with an app backend. Persistent data and user authentication are included for one app on the proposed Free plan, and for every app on Builder and Pro. Review the plan details and test how your forms store and handle enquiries.
